flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No court application batch selection code. Only ocmsadminui NoticeSearch useSearch.getNoticesByCourtBatchNo (defined, never called) and the Icsdbatch/Icourtcase types; no page, route or endpoint in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi.
note: The story asks the CPO to select a batch number in OCMS. There is no UI route for court application in App.tsx (existing routes: batch-furnish, batch-update-odh, report, system admin), no endpoint listing batches in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi, and the OcmsCourtCase entity has no batch column (OcmsCourtCase.java:17-31). The function getNoticesByCourtBatchNo (useSearch.ts:144-150) queries the generic courtcase endpoint by csd_batch_no, but nothing calls it, and it is a CSD/REPCCS batch type, not court application batch selection. No relevant maintenance ticket. Cannot verify from repo: whether the feature exists in another system.
recommendation: Do not claim as completed based on this repo. Confirm with URA/the team where the court application batch code lives; if nowhere, mark it as a gap.

steps.step: The court application batch already holds the notices included earlier (OCMS22.7)
steps.detail: No code: grep for court application / court batch / courtBatch / csd_batch / CourtApplication / process-cpc in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi and thirdpartyapi finds no controller, service or UI page to select or review a court application batch. No batch entity and no process creates a batch number; the court case entity only has notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason.

steps.step: CPO opens the court application page and sees the batch number choices
steps.detail: There is no court application route or page in App.tsx; the System menu only has Court Batch Limit/Duration parameters (System.ts:147-154), not a batch picker.

steps.step: CPO selects one batch number to continue
steps.detail: getNoticesByCourtBatchNo is only a definition and export (useSearch.ts:144-150, :181) with no caller; it is not batch selection and uses csd_batch_no.
